scripts.build:sidecar: bun -e 'import { chmodSync, copyFileSync, mkdirSync, rmSync } from "node:fs"; mkdirSync("resources/darwin-arm64/bin", { recursive: true }); rmSync("resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet-bun", { force: true }); rmSync("resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet-agent.js", { force: true }); copyFileSync(process.execPath, "resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet-bun"); chmodSync("resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet-bun", 0o755);' && bun build sidecar/src/main.ts --target=bun --outfile resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet-agent.js
scripts.build:cli: mkdir -p resources/darwin-arm64/bin && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o resources/darwin-arm64/bin/valet ./cmd/valet
